nodes.label: Algorithms.ETCRealPrefixLawTransport
nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Algorithms.ETCRealPrefixLawTransport
nodes.description: This module factors the native Real ETC commit, action, and finite-horizon kernel regret through the finite exploration reward prefix. It then transports the canonical infinite-product regret bound to an arbitrary probability space from equality of that finite-prefix pushforward law. A final adapter permits an external action process that agrees almost surely with the local ETC action.
